question_en: List recent agreements carrying an FFS (Further For Study) marker (items needing further study).
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.hasFFS = true RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 15
reference_query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WHERE a.hasFFS=true
WITH a,max(meeting.sourceReportedEndDate) AS meetingPeriodEndDate
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(agenda:AgendaItem)
RETURN DISTINCT a.resolutionId AS resolutionId,a.content AS content,meetingPeriodEndDate,
                agenda.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber,a.sequence AS sequence
ORDER BY meetingPeriodEndDate DESC,agendaNumber ASC,sequence ASC,resolutionId ASC
